subject: Commit uplift roadmap & phased rate change
messages:
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: kai.park@parcelone.com
Cc: asha@parcelone.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit uplift roadmap & phased rate change

Hi Kai / Asha,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. ParcelOne's usage pattern over the last quarter shows steady growth in streaming chat and reranking — great to see. As discussed, I've sketched a practical path to increase your monthly committed tokens while smoothing rate changes so your engineers don't see sudden throttles during promotions.

High-level proposal (attached: ParcelOne_MAT_v1.xlsx):
- Month 1 (trial uplift): move from 200M -> 350M committed tokens; keep current rate tier for first 7 days to let traffic stabilize.
- Month 2: full uplift to 500M commit; apply new rate class (Tier 3) with a 10% price delta on outskirts; soft-throttle windows on peak hours in week 1 for safety.
- Ongoing: automated burst allowance for seasonal promotions (configurable).

Open asks:
1) Confirm the preferred effective date for Month 1 uplift (we suggested 2027-08-01).
2) Any procurement/PO timing we should align with?

I'll loop in Karthik and Marissa on the ops/commit scheduling side to coordinate provisioning and any contract addendum.

Thanks — happy to walk through the MAT and the phased schedule on a short call.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: ParcelOne_MAT_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 63kb)
From: kai.park@parcelone.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit uplift roadmap & phased rate change

Jasmine — thanks for the clear note and MAT. This looks reasonable to Asha and me. A couple quick points: 

- We can do the initial uplift effective 2027-08-01.
- Procurement wants a short memo they can attach to the PO explaining the phased billing changes (price tier changes only happen after Month 1).
- Can you confirm the service-level impacts (latency SLA) if we move to Tier 3? We have a Black Friday-like promotion planned for 2027-11 and want to be sure there are guardrails.

If you can send a 1-page summary for procurement and a latency impact note, we’ll fast-track the PO.

— Kai
Kai Park
Head of Engineering | ParcelOne
kai@parcelone.com

Kai — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a one-page memo for procurement (redwood_uplift_summary.pdf). Below are the SLA & ops notes you asked for: 

SLA / latency impact (Tier 3):
- Latency SLO: p95 token latency increase expected +6–12ms under typical load vs current Tier 2, depending on sequence length.
- During the Month 1 trial uplift we will maintain identical routing (no model swap) to avoid regression risks.
- We will enable prefix caching for your high-volume endpoints to offset tail latency.
- For seasonal peak (Black Friday): recommend a canary window and pre-warm plan 2 weeks out. Ops will add an explicit fallback to Tier 2-compatible variant for critical routes.

Ops / provisioning notes:
- Karthik / Marissa: please provision the additional Dedicated pool capacity for ParcelOne starting 2027-07-30; enable a soft-throttle policy (threshold-based, 95th percentile) during the first 7 days post-uplift.
- Billing: apply upgraded commit effective 2027-08-01 but delay price-tier ramp until 2027-09-01 if ParcelOne prefers an extended trial. (Kai — confirm).

Let me know if you want a quick call with Karthik and Marissa to walk through the provisioning checklist.

Best,
Jasmine

Attachments: redwood_uplift_summary.pdf (pdf, 12kb); ParcelOne_MAT_v1.xlsx
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit uplift roadmap & phased rate change

Thanks for the heads-up — noted. Operational checklist we’ll run through: 
1) Reserve a Dedicated pool: 4 x A100-equivalent nodes for 2 months (7/30–9/30) for onboarding traffic.
2) Enable prefix caching for /v1/chat and /v1/rerank endpoints.
3) Configure soft-throttle: start at 95th percentile threshold; alert to SRE if triggered >3x in 24h.
4) Canary plan: 5% traffic for first 48 hours post-full uplift; automatic rollback window of 6 hours if errors >1.5%.

Marissa — can you confirm the provisioning ETA for the pool and whether we need a ticket to capacity planning? Ben — I’ll need a quick check on pricing impact for a 60-day reserve.

—Karthik
Principal Infra PM | Redwood Inference

Karthik — provisioning ETA: can reserve the Dedicated pool and have nodes standing by by 2027-07-29 end of day. I’m opening CAP-3421 with infra (estimated fulfillment 7/29).

Ben — for the billing side, if we implement a delayed tier ramp to 2027-09-01 (as Jasmine suggested), the net ARR impact for parcelone at the current volumes is ~+18% across months 2–6 vs the original plan; I’ll send a short note to finance.

Marissa Cole
